_doc: Evidence-backed price and share-basis decisions. One register; no ticker branches in application code.
share_events separates actual ordinary-share changes G, vendor-incorporated restatements F, represented price factors Y and quoted-security units U.
S=Y*H/(F*U); vendor PIT shares=sharesbas/F; traded quoted price=close_split*S*F*U. H is a separately verified hidden price-only wedge.
Actual stock dividends can change G without entering F when original filing anchors prove the vendor did not restate its historical shares.
Cash dividends never become share-count factors. Yahoo Adj Close maps to close_total and includes its ordinary dividend treatment.
Each policy has exact source expectations, sourced ordinary-share and/or traded-quote anchors, actual/date/ratio, optional vendor and price legs, and optional quote_units.
An omitted vendor leg defaults to actual; ratio1 means no vendor restatement. An omitted price leg preserves the selected Yahoo feed dates and factors.
Missing or moved price factors require independent quoted_price anchors on repaired close_split. A price anchor cannot authorize a quantity adjustment.
Applicable changed/unavailable source or anchor evidence refuses the new policy before writes; exact healed events replace once. Verified empty and unavailable sources differ.
Quote anchors use shared split-vintage and legacy all-price repairs, including bounded older history for tail builds. Total-only repairs do not change close_split.
Price anchors overlapping nonunit hidden level segments are explicitly unsupported until the combined basis is independently verified; a declared H cannot authorize itself.
Quote-unit title aliases are explicit and case/whitespace normalized. Ambiguous titles in a nonunitary era abstain; no general ADR or common-class inference.
level_factor contains only independently measured hidden price wedges, in nonoverlapping [previous before,before) segments. before is exclusive.
BLDR and CCI boundaries use observed daily quote discontinuities (2009-12-17 and2002-05-29), not filing-gap midpoints. Their precise corporate causes remain unproven.
HBAN/APA/SJM legacy ladders were removed atomically; their levels derive from F/U and must not be multiplied a second time.
split_vintage repairs alternating old/new split vintages across all five price legs, preserving volume.
Legacy return_seams without fields retain all-price/close_split-guard/target-one behavior (JCI).
Total-only return_seams require fields=[close_total], expect_step, target_step, expect_quote_step, evidence. Only the strict pre-event close_total prefix moves by observed_step/target_step.
VTR target gross1.0025540368759251 includes one CCP per four VTR; SJM target gross1.0401776947657886 uses legal0.9451 ordinary-share conversion, independently of vendor0.945 rounding.
APPLIED and precise ALREADY_VERIFIED total states recover total-return windows. REFUSED/UNKNOWN (including interior missing/nonpositive adjacent prices) stops the builder.
Residual quote seams are measured independently on unchanged close_split and keep ATR/gap/range windows masked even after total-return recovery.
null_ret retains five unresolved returns: DHR, ETN, LDOS, DD, CNP. VTR was removed only with the supported total-only repair.
volume_scale is a separately measured volume-unit repair. seam_reviewed declares a reviewed move for validation and changes no data.
Legacy repairs keep their existing remeasurement/skip behavior. New share policies and total-only returns fail closed on conflicting evidence.
Historical adoption requires affected merged fundamentals, full historical prices, their consumers and cube assembly; a tail-only build does not rewrite old prefixes.

_APPROVED.note: Every `factor` is the measured median of sharadar.price / close_split over the segment, with spread <= 0.06% within each. Every `step` is the observed one-bar ratio in `prices`.

IP.evidence: Two spinoffs Yahoo back-adjusted the whole history for and published NO prices_splits row for. Returns around both dates are <3%, so the adjustment is smooth and correct FOR RETURNS -- it is only the LEVEL that is left short. 107 of 127 filing rows fail invariant 1 without this.

HWM.evidence: Howmet's 2020 Arconic separation. Yahoo back-adjusted the history and published no prices_splits row. Corroborated by sharadar_actions 2020-04-01 spinoff of ARNC (value 0.25).

BX.evidence: Blackstone's PJT Partners separation. No prices_splits row; corroborated by sharadar_actions 2015-10-01 spinoff of PJT (value 0.025). A small wedge (1.9%) but a perfectly flat one across all 33 affected rows.

BLDR.evidence: A flat 18.9% wedge across all 18 pre-2010 filing rows, spread 0.00%. ⚠ NO corroborating corporate action was found in sharadar_actions -- the shape is unambiguous (a perfect plateau that ends), the CAUSE is not. Builders FirstSource ran a rights offering and a debt exchange through 2009-2010, either of which would do this.

MNST.evidence: Yahoo back-adjusted FIVE bars for the 2026-08-11 two-for-one and left the other 7,793 alone. The five (2026-07-20, 07-21, 07-22, 07-31, 08-06) sit as islands inside the unadjusted run, so close_split reads 97.65 -> 48.19 -> 93.55 -> 47.08 -> 90.36 -> 45.53 with nothing in the market to explain it. The ten island edges are steps of 0.4895, 1.9559, 0.4935, 1.9413, 0.4984 and 1.9193 -- every one within 5% of 2.0 or 0.5, and the largest genuine MNST move in thirty years is +45.5%, so nothing real is near the flip band.
MNST.corroboration: sharadar.price / close_split is 0.50000 on all 122 filing rows from 1996-05-10 to 2026-08-07, flat to five decimals -- Sharadar carries the whole series on the post-split basis. Sharadar's 45.18 on 2026-08-07 equals 90.36 / 2 exactly. sharadar_actions has no MNST row after 2016-11-10, so the vendor's ACTION feed is stale even though its PRICE is right; the split is in prices_splits (2026-08-11, ratio 2.0), which is what `ratio` here refers to.
MNST.note: ⚠ The only entry that is direction-aware per bar, and the only one that is NOT a stale-extract artifact -- re-fetched live from Yahoo on 2026-09-01 and reproduced exactly. Volume is deliberately left alone: 10.8M on the last stale bar against 10.1M on the next adjusted one is no evidence of a re-basing, and inventing a factor for a leg with no measured defect is how a register starts lying.

JCI.evidence: JCI's prices before 2016-09-02 are Tyco International's (TYC; JCI plc is the renamed Tyco, which acquired old Johnson Controls). On 2007-07-02 Tyco did a 1-for-4 reverse split and, the same day, spun off Covidien (COV) and TE Connectivity (TEL): Sharadar's TYC actions for that date are split 0.25, spinoff COV and spinoff TEL (spinoffdividend 46 and 42.53). Yahoo's feed states the 0.25 and close_split applies it, but neither adjusts the two distributions, so close_split falls 70.354 -> 27.775 in one bar (x0.3948): a -60.52% return that holders never had, since the value moved into their COV and TEL shares. Old Johnson Controls' own 3-for-1 of 2007-10-03 is another company's event and does not belong to these prices.
JCI.note: ⚠ This repairs the fabricated RETURN, which is what reaches momentum, vol, betas and every JCI label. The LEVEL basis is separate: inside the JCI <- TYC vendor-series window the cube's level factor reads TYC's own corporate actions (security_master_manual.json vendor_series_overrides), and this seam does not change it.

DHR.evidence: close_total steps +61.22% in one bar and level_factor steps 1.487832 -> 1.128000 on the same date. sharadar_actions carries a spinoff 0.5 -> FTV with a 25.65 spinoff dividend there, and prices_splits a 1.319 ratio: an event both feeds agree happened, so the +61% is the seam between close_total's two bases, not a move. Mean |epsilon| over the 60d before/after is 8.94 -> 0.39, a 23x swing against a random-date control median 0.986x.

ETN.evidence: The 2001-01-02 close_total seam is +22.886%. Axcelis's 2000 Form10-K confirms the December29,2000 distribution of1.179023 ACLS shares per ETN share; January2 is the next trading session. Sharadar's missing action is a feed omission, not an uncorroborated event. The additional return adjustment1.191032426 matches the recorded2.616 dividend to rounding. ACLS event-day close is not stored, so no exact replacement holder return is asserted; keep the guarded null. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1113232/000111323201500003/form10k.htm

LDOS.evidence: close_total steps +15.01% in one bar and level_factor steps 1.620000 -> 1.000000. Three co-dated events: sharadar_actions carries a spinoff 0.57143 -> SAIC AND a 0.25 split, prices_splits a 0.405 ratio, and the SAI -> LDOS ticker change lands 2013-09-27. The legs cannot be separated from one another here, which is precisely why this is a null. Mean |epsilon| over the 60d before/after is 1.21 -> 0.50, a 2.4x swing against 0.986x.

DD.evidence: close_total steps +17.82% in one bar and level_factor steps 3.387859 -> 2.390000. Four co-dated events on the DWDP -> DD ticker change: sharadar_actions carries a spinoff 0.33333 -> CTVA, a 79.62 spinoff dividend AND a 0.33333 split, and prices_splits a 0.4725 ratio. Neither the residual level nor the correct return is separable from that stack. Mean |epsilon| over the 60d before/after is 0.64 -> 0.41, a 1.6x swing against 0.986x.

CNP.evidence: close_total steps +17.83% in one bar and level_factor steps 1.186240 -> 1.000000, EXACTLY the 1.186240 ratio in prices_splits. sharadar_actions carries a spinoff 0.7886 -> GEN1 with a 1.5 spinoff dividend on the same date, so the event is real and only the price leg's basis is in question. Mean |epsilon| over the 60d before/after is 0.28 -> 0.24, the mildest of the five retained -- registered because it is the same mechanism, not because the label damage is large.

BRK-A.evidence: Yahoo BRK-A volume (re-fetched 2026-10-05, 2008-01-02..2026-10-02) steps 24,800 on 2013-07-26 -> 300 on 2013-07-29 and stays in the hundreds (median 300 in 2014, 200 in 2015) after a 2008-2013 run of 29,050-86,050 a year. The 20-bar median jump across the boundary is 106.8. Every bar before it is a round hundred, the shape of a count in hundreds of shares.
BRK-A.corroboration: Dollar volume against BRK-B, the same issuer's other class: BRK-A / BRK-B median per year is 13-95x in 2008-2013 and 0.10-0.14x in 2014-2020 (`_out/q2e_summary.txt` of the entity-symbol-lineage run); a class 1,500x BRK-B's price cannot trade 13x its dollars. After the repair it reads 0.15-0.23 in 2010-2013 and 0.82-0.95 in 2008-2009, before BRK-B's 50:1 split and index entry made it the liquid line (`_out/q2m_brka_summary.txt`).
